description_zh: 查询数据集成新版任务列表，包括整库同步实时任务，整库同步离线任务，单表同步实时任务等数据集成任务
name: ListDIJobs

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages are numbered starting from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default: 10. Maximum: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的数据条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Data Integration job.

The name must be unique within the DataWorks workspace
parameters.help_zh:
导出任务的名称。

名称必须唯一，即当前DataWorks工作空间中不能存在名称重复的导出任务
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the source data source. If you do not specify this parameter, jobs are not filtered by this criterion. Valid values: `PolarDB`, `MySQL`, `Kafka`, `LogHub`, `Hologres`, `Oracle`, `OceanBase`, `MongoDB`, `RedShift`, `Hive`, `SQLServer`, `Doris`, and `ClickHouse`
parameters.help_zh: 源端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：PolarDB，MySQL，Kafka，LogHub，Hologres，Oracle，OceanBase，MongoDB，RedShift，Hive，SQLServer，Doris，ClickHouse
parameters.name: source_data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination data source. If you do not specify this parameter, jobs are not filtered by this criterion. Valid values: `Hologres`, `OSS-HDFS`, `OSS`, `MaxCompute`, `LogHub`, `StarRocks`, `DataHub`, `AnalyticDB_For_MySQL`, `Kafka`, and `Hive`
parameters.help_zh: 目标端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：Hologres，OSS-HDFS，OSS，MaxCompute，LogHub，StarRocks，DataHub，AnalyticDB_For_MySQL，Kafka，Hive
parameters.name: destination_data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:

`FullAndRealtimeIncremental`: full and real-time incremental synchronization

`RealtimeIncremental`: real-time incremental synchronization

`Full`: full synchronization

`OfflineIncremental`: offline incremental synchronization

`FullAndOfflineIncremental`: full and offline incremental synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步类型，可选的枚举值有：
FullAndRealtimeIncremental（全量和实时增量）
RealtimeIncremental（实时增量）
Full（全量）
OfflineIncremental（离线增量）
FullAndOfflineIncremental（全量+离线增量）
parameters.name: migration_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration type of the job. Valid values: `FILESPEC`, `CLASSIC`, and `ALL`. `FILESPEC` indicates a new job type configured based on a structured file specification. `CLASSIC` indicates a job configured in the traditional mode. If you set this parameter to `ALL`, jobs of both types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置规范类型。可选FILESPEC、CLASSIC、ALL。FILESPEC：基于结构化 filespec 的新版任务；CLASSIC：传统配置模式的任务；
parameters.name: spec_type

DIJobs.description_en: A list of Data Integration jobs

items.description_en: Details of a Data Integration job

DIJobId.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the `Id` parameter instead
DIJobId.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用Id字段

DestinationDataSourceType.description_en: The type of the destination data source. Valid values: `Hologres`, `OSS-HDFS`, `OSS`, `MaxCompute`, `LogHub`, `StarRocks`, `DataHub`, `AnalyticDB_For_MySQL`, `Kafka`, and `Hive`

Id.description_en: The ID of the Data Integration job

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

`Finished`: The job completed successfully.

`Initialized`: The job is initialized.

`Stopped`: The job is stopped.

`Failed`: The job failed.

`Running`: The job is running.

`Stopping`: The job is being stopped
JobStatus.description_zh:
同步状态，可选的枚举值：
Finished（运行成功已结束）
Initialized（初始化完成）
Stopped（已停止）
Failed（运行失败）
Running（运行中）
Stopping（停止中）

MigrationType.description_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:

`FullAndRealtimeIncremental`: full and real-time incremental synchronization

`RealtimeIncremental`: real-time incremental synchronization

`Full`: full synchronization

`OfflineIncremental`: offline incremental synchronization

`FullAndOfflineIncremental`: full and offline incremental synchronization
MigrationType.description_zh:
同步类型，可选的枚举值有：
FullAndRealtimeIncremental（全量和实时增量）
RealtimeIncremental（实时增量）
Full（全量）
OfflineIncremental（离线增量）
FullAndOfflineIncremental（全量+离线增量）

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace that contains the job

SourceDataSourceType.description_en: The type of the source data source. Valid values: `PolarDB`, `MySQL`, `Kafka`, `LogHub`, `Hologres`, `Oracle`, `OceanBase`, `MongoDB`, `RedShift`, `Hive`, `SQLServer`, `Doris`, and `ClickHouse`

PageNumber.description_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the filter criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数
